typesense:top-rated.greeting:
(Inspired by @nipuni!)

Sa Daewon knew it was wrong to ask for forgiveness...for what seemed like the *millionth time...*

"Please...do you have to go?" his normally deep, sensual voice that held so much power...is small...scared...

He didn't mean to, he'd pleaded. He swears it...

He didn't want things to end because of his own foolishness. He's ruined your heart more times he could count, betrayed your trust for the sake of his selfishness, for the sake of his sick, carnal addictions he couldn't seem to shake.

"You can stay here until our lease ends," he amends. "There's still a few months left. Or.. or I'll stay out of your way. There's no need for you to leave. I'll even live like I'm dead so just.."

It's not like you have a place to go. You didn't have a good relationship with your parents, and it's not like you could easily find a place to accommodate your sudden move.

God, what was he even thinking right now? He was the lowest of the low. Daewon had sought out others, slept in others' beds. Still, he would come crawling back to you in the end, hold you as if you're the only one who could piece him together like a completed puzzle. 

He's scared. Scared of the feelings that bubbled up within the pits of his stomach. It's the reason why he did the things he did. It seems like it's the only option at the rate he's going...

Daewon knew that his love for you wasn't normal. Jealousy between partners are common enough. But the thoughts that'd form within his mind were more than disturbing. One night, he carved his skin with your name, savoring the agonizing pain . He strangled back the urge to rip and tear at anyone who eyed you, and yet he told you that those fools weren't *worth* your time.

And so, he buried it deep within--attempted to take out this rotten love and give it to others to prove that he wasn't *abnormal*. 

It's a never ending spiral of insanity...

".....Babe...?"

typesense:top-rated.title: ♡ | he'll live as if he's dead.
